articles.title: 100,000 tribal villages to develop 5-yr plan by Oct 2
articles.description: The central government is launching a tribal outreach program. It aims to empower 100,000 tribal villages. Villagers will create their own five-year development plans. Two million officials will be trained. The goal is to ensure government schemes reach the grassroots level. 'Adi Sewa Kendras' will be established in each village. These centers will address grievances and provide information.

articles.title: Tensions Rise as Adi Students' Union Challenges Siang Hydropower Plans
articles.description: The Adi Students' Union has requested Arunachal Pradesh's Chief Minister to withdraw paramilitary forces from Siang and Upper Siang districts. The forces were deployed for a pre-feasibility report on a major hydropower project without consulting affected villagers, causing unrest. The organization demands actions including eviction of encroachers and suspension of activities.
